title: Dad's old records

old_story: On Sunday, Anna's dad opens an old box. Inside, there are old records on [[vinyl]] and some [[CDs|CD]]. He plays them on his big [[stereo]]. First, they listen to [[rock and roll]], then loud [[hard rock]]. "At school, I loved [[punk]] and [[new wave]]," Dad says. "I was a real [[rocker]] with long hair." He even played guitar in a [[rock band]]. Grandpa was a [[hippie]], and he played the [[banjo]]. "Now there is a [[revival]] of our music," Dad says happily. "It was a great [[era]]." Anna puts on Dad's [[retro]] jacket and asks, "Can I keep it?"

title: Max's first rave
scene: Max goes to a rave in an old factory - a mega party. The DJ plays a long mix of techno and acid house, a girl in goth clothes plays a synth, and a punk rock band plays at sunrise.

old_story: On Saturday night, Max goes to his first [[rave]] in an old factory. It is a [[mega]] party with hundreds of people and colorful lights. The DJ plays a long [[mix]] that starts with fast [[techno]]. Then the music turns into old [[acid house]], and everyone jumps. Next to Max, a quiet [[goth]] in black clothes plays a [[synth]] on a small stage. At sunrise, a band plays loud [[punk rock]], and Max dances until his legs hurt. In the morning, he texts Anna: "I need to sleep for two days!"

old_story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[songwriter]] who writes songs in her small room. She loves [[folk]], but she also listens to calm [[new age]] music. One day, a [[producer]] hears her songs and invites her to his studio. With her friend Oleh, she records a [[duet]] about the rain. He adds a long [[instrumental]] in the middle of the song. Later, a DJ makes a [[remix]], and it sounds great at parties. They plan the [[release]] of her [[debut]] album for May. The [[title track]] is a song about Kyiv at night. When the album comes out, the whole family listens to it together.

old_story: Taras gets a big [[role]] in the school play. The show is at the city [[theater]] on Friday. The play is a [[drama]] about a lost kingdom. Taras plays a young [[prince]]. He is the [[protagonist]], so he has many lines. In the second act, he says a long [[monologue]]. In the next scene, a [[poet]] reads a [[sonnet]] at a [[masquerade]]. Before they start, every [[actor]] is nervous, but Taras is calm. Their teacher knows the whole school [[repertoire]] by heart. After the show, she says, "Taras, you have real [[talent]]!"

title: An evening of comedy

old_story: On Friday, Anna and her friends start their comedy weekend with an [[improv]] show. After that, they see a short [[stand-up]] set by a nervous young comedian. On Saturday, they go to a [[cabaret]], where a [[drag queen]] welcomes everyone. The evening ends with a [[revue]] of songs from a famous [[musical]]. On Sunday, they buy cheap tickets for the [[matinee]] and laugh at a comedy [[duo]]. One joke about cats is a total [[fail]], but the two comedians laugh at it too. In the evening, they go to a charity [[gala]] at the city theater. There, an old [[artiste]] with great [[humor]] sings and tells funny stories. The last act is a short [[farce]] about two lost brothers. At midnight, Max says, "My face hurts from laughing!"
